claim:pathway-revision.proposition: Executed through the engine on a held-out substrate pulse, the structural revision (adding product feedback) reproduces the true model's peak intermediate, while a parameter refit and the unrevised baseline do not — structural revision, not parameter fitting, is the adequate model.

narrative.question: A two-step pathway model matches a training substrate pulse but a structural inadequacy is suspected. Does a parameter refit or a structural revision (adding product-feedback inhibition) generalize to held-out pulses, and does the revised composite earn its verdict through the engine?
